article.title: Publication for fraudulent purpose.
article.content:
74Publication for fraudulent purpose.

Section 74  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 29 of the Act
Whoever knowingly creates, publishes or otherwise makes available a 2[electronic signature] Certificate for any fraudulent or unlawful purpose shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees, or with both.
2 Subs. by Act 10 of 2009, s. 2, for “digital signature” (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
